From Osiris · Price: the target must agree to the bet.

Theme Fate

  • 1: 1 minute: propose a bet, settled by an opposed check you both agree on. If the target agrees and loses, it takes –1 to checks against you for 1 day. In combat, 1 action: challenge a creature within 30 ft; if it refuses, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} and your stand's next Strike against it this turn is made against an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} target.
  • 5: Surge: if the target loses, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1}.
  • 9: The loser's soul goes into a coin: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{unconscious} for 1 minute (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates, incapacitation).
  • 13: You can bet on a fight's outcome; it's settled when the fight ends.
  • 17: You can bet with up to three creatures.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
